outcome: Incidence of transient tachypnea of the newborn
cohort: 259 neonates born via elective cesarean section at Tottori University Hospital, between January 2013 and December 2019, with birthweights ≥ 2500 g and gestational ages > 37 weeks
finding: Elective cesarean sections at 37 weeks of gestational age exhibited an increased risk of transient tachypnea of the newborn than elective cesarean sections at ≥ 38 weeks of gestational age.
